{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Customer age -1 count:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for the QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print("Refunded orders count:", refunded_count)

# Check the unique channels
print("Unique channels:", df['channel'].unique())

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
print("Channel vs customer_segment cross-tab:")
df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)"}
